topic: Reviewing classification and staging environment setup
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on reviewing the current classification logic in the staging environment. It was noted that while some preliminary work, such as adding Brazilian road data to the sandbox, has been completed, it is not yet fully functional for production use.

A key challenge identified is determining how various metrics will be calculated given the volume of partner data and lack of clear requirements from stakeholders (specifically mentioning needing input from someone regarding calculation logic).

Regarding testing environments, [p1] requested a dedicated test account on the production database to facilitate adding test facilities with Brazilian addresses for easier data handling by someone else. [me] provided an email alias solution using Gmail aliases.
decisions: The current classification status was reviewed in staging/sandbox.
A plan is needed to determine how metrics will be calculated from partner data.
action_items: Determine the calculation logic for various metrics based on partner data inputs.
Use Gmail aliases (e.g., +1, +2) as a solution for creating multiple test accounts/aliases.
